transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… it’s kind of embarrassing. I guess I’m here because when I eat too much, I end up making myself throw up after. I do it so I don’t gain weight, but… it’s gotten to the point where I’m scared I can’t stop.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

For the last few months… at least three, I guess… there’s hardly been a week I haven’t done it. Usually after I eat late at night. Some weeks it’s more than once, especially if I’m stuck at home more because of my back.
Do you often limit the amount or type of food you eat to avoid gaining weight?
I don’t know… not in any planned way, I guess. I don’t really keep track of that.
Have you had any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
I’m not really sure. I don’t weigh myself much, and I haven’t noticed anything major… not that I can say for sure.
Do you worry about being fat or gaining weight even when you're at a normal weight?

Yeah… I do. Even if it’s just like a pound up on the scale, I kind of panic. I start thinking I’ve gotten soft from being laid up with my back, and then I’m already trying to figure out how to fix it.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that's definitely larger than what most people would eat in a short period of time?
Yeah… mostly at night. When everyone’s quiet, I’ll end up in the kitchen and just… eat whatever’s there. Leftovers, cereal, chips, ice cream. It can go way past a normal meal.
Do you make yourself throw up after these late-night eating episodes because you feel guilty about how much you've eaten?
Yeah… I do. I go to the bathroom after and make myself throw up. I hate saying that, but… I get scared I’ll gain weight, and lately it feels like I can’t really stop.
Do you feel like you have control over what you're eating during those late-night episodes?
Not really. Once I start, it’s like… my hands just keep getting more food even while I’m telling myself, “Lucy, stop.” I don’t feel like I’m back in control until it’s already over.
Do you think you would still make yourself throw up if you didn't worry about gaining weight?
I… I don’t think so. It’s mostly because I’m scared I’ll gain weight after I eat too much. That’s why I end up in the bathroom making myself throw up… and it’s gotten hard to stop.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterwards?

Yeah… there have been times. Mostly at night, when the house is quiet, I’ll end up in the kitchen eating whatever’s there—leftovers, cereal, chips, ice cream. It’s… more than a normal meal. Sometimes I don’t throw up after, but I still know it was a lot.
Do you only make yourself throw up after eating a large amount of food because you're afraid of gaining weight from it?
Yeah… mostly. If I eat too much, I start panicking about gaining weight, and then I go make myself throw up. It’s… hard to stop once that starts.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating a normal amount of food, not after one of those late-night episodes where you eat a lot?
Not really… it’s mostly after I’ve eaten too much. Then I get scared about gaining weight and I end up in the bathroom making myself throw up. It feels like I can’t stop sometimes.
Do you usually feel a lack of control over your eating during those times when you eat a large amount of food?

Yeah… I do. Once I start, it’s like I’m not really in charge anymore. I’ll be telling myself to stop, like, “Lucy, knock it off,” but my hands just keep grabbing more food. I don’t really feel back in control until it’s already over.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating a normal meal, without having eaten a lot beforehand?
No… not usually after a normal meal. It’s after I eat too much, then I get scared about gaining weight and I go make myself throw up. It’s gotten… hard to stop.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating normally, without having had one of those large eating episodes beforehand?

No… it’s not really after eating normally. It’s when I eat too much, and then I panic about gaining weight and go make myself throw up. I know I’ve said that already, but… that’s the part I’m scared I can’t stop.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating when you haven't eaten a lot?
No… not if I haven’t eaten a lot. It’s mostly after I’ve eaten too much, then I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I’m scared I’ll gain weight. It’s… hard to stop.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating normally, without feeling like you've eaten an unusually large amount of food?
No… not really after a normal amount. It’s when I feel like I ate too much. Then I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. I’m… scared I can’t stop.
Do you ever use any other methods to try to prevent weight gain after you eat, besides making yourself throw up?
Um… I don’t know. Mostly it’s just the throwing up. I can’t really think of anything else I do.
Do you try to limit or avoid eating certain foods or skip meals on days when you haven't had one of those late-night eating episodes?
I’m not sure… I don’t really keep track like that. I guess I haven’t noticed doing anything specific with foods or meals on those days.
